_comment: Phase 0 replay corpus. Sourced from /home/deploy/.pm2/logs/discord-bot-out*.log (real) plus synthetic coverage. Read-only fixture; the harness never posts to Discord or writes to the database.

_fields.question: the message text, verbatim
_fields.origin: real = replayed from production logs | synthetic = written for coverage
_fields.selfContained: true only if the question is fully answerable without conversation history. Governs cache sharing and fact routing.
_fields.expectRoute: metric the deterministic router is expected to CLAIM (null = must not claim it)
_fields.expectMustNotRoute: reason the question must NOT be answered by a deterministic fact, or null
_fields.history: prior turns as [{role, content}] — reproduces real conversational context
_fields.expectOutcome: answer | decline | fallthrough — what the fact layer should do. "decline" means the router claimed it but the fact layer must refuse (e.g. currency not present).

questions.expectMustNotRoute: conversational/vague; needs platform narrative, not a metric
